name: 32931 · Cocoa Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 32931 (Cocoa Beach) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32931 (Cocoa Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32931 (Cocoa Beach) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 69% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
